import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from harness import *
EMPTY=sha(b'')
def A(payload,pn,ann=0,phase=0,dcid=b'\xaa',width=None):
    w = width if width else 4
    return datagram((0x40|(phase<<2)|(w-1)).to_bytes(1,'big')+dcid+pn.to_bytes(w,'big')+payload,[ann])
def I(payload,pn=0,ann=0):
    return datagram(bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x01\xbb'+v(0)+v(1+len(payload))+pn.to_bytes(1,'big')+payload,[ann])

# ACK rollback on later frame error
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(0)+v(5)+b'\x20',0)]))
check('ack-rollback',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['acknowledged'][2]['count'],t['acknowledged'][2]['intervals']),( 'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',0,0))
# ECN rollback
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x03'+v(5)+v(0)+v(0)+v(5)+v(1)+v(2)+v(3)+b'\x20',0)]))
check('ecn-rollback',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['acknowledged'][2]['ecn']),('FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',[0,0,0]))
# max data / max streams rollback
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x10'+v(9)+b'\x20',0), A(b'\x12'+v(9)+b'\x20',1)]))
check('max-rollback',(t['send_max_data'],t['send_max_streams'],t['packets'][1]['status']),(0,{'bidi':0,'uni':0},'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'))
# stop/reset rollback
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x05'+v(0)+v(9)+b'\x20',0), A(b'\x04'+v(0)+v(9)+v(3)+b'\x20',1)]))
check('stop-rollback',(t['streams'],t['opened']),([],{'bidi':0,'uni':0}))
# crypto rollback
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x06'+v(0)+v(1)+b'x'+b'\x20',0)]))
check('crypto-rollback',(t['crypto'][2]['unique'],t['crypto'][2]['ranges']),(0,[]))
# rollback across many kinds in one packet
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']},
             A(b'\x10'+v(5)+b'\x02'+v(3)+v(0)+v(0)+v(3)+b'\x0e'+v(0)+v(0)+v(1)+b'z'+b'\x18'+v(1)+v(0)+b'\x01\xdd'+b'\x00'*16+b'\x20',0)]))
check('multi-rollback',(t['send_max_data'],t['acknowledged'][2]['count'],t['streams'],t['peer_cids']),
      (0,0,[],[{'sequence':0,'id':'cc','token':'00'*16}]))
# multi-commit in one packet
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']},
             A(b'\x10'+v(5)+b'\x02'+v(3)+v(0)+v(0)+v(3)+b'\x0e'+v(0)+v(0)+v(1)+b'z'+b'\x18'+v(1)+v(0)+b'\x01\xdd'+b'\x00'*16,0)]))
check('multi-commit',(t['send_max_data'],t['acknowledged'][2]['count'],t['streams'][0]['high'],t['peer_cids'],t['opened']),
      (5,4,1,[{'sequence':0,'id':'cc','token':'00'*16},{'sequence':1,'id':'dd','token':'00'*16}],{'bidi':1,'uni':0}))
# level/sender matrix
cases=[('ping-I',I(b'\x01'),'OK'),('ack-I',I(b'\x02'+v(1)+v(0)+v(0)+v(1)),'OK'),
       ('crypto-I',I(b'\x06'+v(0)+v(1)+b'z'),'OK'),('close-I',I(b'\x1c'+v(1)+v(0)+v(0)),'PEER_CLOSE'),
       ('padding-I',I(b'\x00\x01'),'OK')]
for name,wire,exp in cases:
    t=one(trace([{'keys':['I','H']}, wire]))
    check(name,(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][0]['level']),((exp,'I')))
# A-only frames at I level
for name,payload in [('stop',b'\x05'+v(0)+v(1)),('reset',b'\x04'+v(0)+v(1)+v(1)),('maxdata',b'\x10'+v(1)),
                     ('maxstreams',b'\x12'+v(1)),('blocked',b'\x14'+v(1)),('path',b'\x1a'+b'12345678'),
                     ('datagram',b'\x30zz'),('appclose',b'\x1d'+v(1)+v(0)),('ncid',b'\x18'+v(1)+v(0)+b'\x01\xdd'+b'\x00'*16),
                     ('retire',b'\x19'+v(1)),('stream',b'\x08'+v(0)+b'zz'),('sdb',b'\x15'+v(0)+v(1)),
                     ('msd',b'\x11'+v(0)+v(1)),('sb',b'\x16'+v(1)),('maxstreamdata',b'\x11'+v(0)+v(1))]:
    t=one(trace([{'keys':['I']}, I(payload)]))
    check('Aonly-'+name,t['packets'][0]['status'],'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION')
# ACK prefix and count edges

check('ack-pn0',(t['acknowledged'][0]['count'],t['acknowledged'][0]['intervals'],t['acknowledged'][0]['prefix']),(1,1,1))
# datagram with 3 accepted packets bytes/hash
a=I(b'\x01',0); b2=I(b'\x00',1); c=I(b'\x01',2)
t=one(trace([{'keys':['I']}, datagram(a+b2+c,[0,0,0])]))
check('three-packets',[p['status'] for p in t['packets']],['OK','OK','OK'])
check('three-bytes',t['datagrams'][0]['bytes'],len(a)+len(b2)+len(c))
check('three-hash',t['datagrams'][0]['sha256'],sha(a+b2+c))
check('three-accepted',t['datagrams'][0]['accepted'],3)
